minutes.headline: Board endorsed three ANR plans, continued the 494 Electric Ave hearing to Dec 9, and held a decision for corrections.
minutes.summary: The board endorsed ANR plans for 100 Townsend Harbor Road, Goodridge Street/Reservoir Road and 32 Spring Street. It continued the 494 Electric Ave site plan and stormwater hearing to December 9, pending a peer review and town counsel's view on an unadopted street. The 1260 Reservoir Road decision was held over so its standard conditions could be checked. The board also took committee reports, discussed timing for MBTA Communities zoning after the master plan, and agreed to scratch the December 23 meeting.

public_comment.topic: Urged the board to help local businesses through permitting and avoid delays and legal costs; supported commercial development.
Echoed support for commercial development and for the 494 Electric Ave project; said he had other concerns to raise at the next meeting.
Asked about the unadopted street, what adoption would allow, and whether other roads are in the same situation.
Cited the Old Mill in Westminster as an example of parking on both sides of a road; called the issue mostly about ownership of the street.

votes.motion: Endorse ANR plan for 100 Townsend Harbor Road
Endorse ANR plan for Goodridge Street and Reservoir Road, Lots 1 to 6
Endorse ANR plan for 32 Spring Street
Continue the public hearing for 494 Electric Ave to December 9 at 6:05 p.m.
Approve minutes of the September 9 and September 23, 2024 meetings

budget_items.what_was_said: Staff said funding arranged through Mass Housing Partnership would pay a consultant to help with the zoning process.

budget_items.topic: Town manager search staffing agency contract
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said the contract with Community Paradigm Associates is roughly this amount, argued it is worthwhile against the cost of a bad hire.
The committee is expediting a contract using ARPA money; only one on-time response to the RFP was received.
Members asked whether the contract limits public meetings; the planner could not recall the wording and has not obtained a copy. The project is thought within budget.

budget_items.topic: MBTA Communities compliance and state grants
budget_items.what_was_said: Non-compliance could make the town ineligible for competitive state grants; the application deadline was described as June.

decisions.decision: The 1260 Reservoir Road decision will not be signed tonight; staff will correct the cover page and verify standard conditions (construction hours) for signature on December 9.
The December 23 meeting is scratched; staff will offer alternative dates if a time-sensitive item arises (a site plan modification for Village of Flat Hills).
Board consensus to complete the master plan before bringing MBTA Communities zoning forward; it goes on agendas starting in January.
Staff will look into posting the December 4 public meeting so it can serve as a master plan steering committee meeting for quorum.
Hearings for 791 and 795 Leominster Road and 70 Kilburn Street are continued to December 9 at the applicants' request; no vote needed.
Going forward staff will prepare a final decision document for signature on the day of the meeting.

what_happened.line: The board endorsed ANR plans for 100 Townsend Harbor Road, Goodridge Street/Reservoir Road and 32 Spring Street, each by vote.
The 494 Electric Ave site plan and stormwater hearing was continued to December 9, pending a peer review and town counsel's view on an unadopted street.
The 1260 Reservoir Road decision was held, not signed; staff will correct the cover page and check standard conditions for signature December 9.
Board consensus was to finish the master plan before bringing MBTA Communities zoning forward, starting on agendas in January.
The December 23 meeting was scratched, with alternative dates offered only if a time-sensitive item arises.

why_it_matters: The 494 Electric Ave project, and the question of whether its access street is a town-adopted road, stays undecided until at least December 9, so neighbors and businesses have another chance to be heard.

MBTA Communities zoning is pushed behind the master plan, and staff said non-compliance could make the town ineligible for competitive state grants, so the timing is a trade-off residents may be asked to vote on.
watch_next: December 9 meeting: the 494 Electric Ave hearing continuation, the 1260 Reservoir Road decision for signature, and continued hearings at 791 and 795 Leominster Road and 70 Kilburn Street.
January agendas: MBTA Communities zoning is due to appear after the master plan work.
